name: Nagar Nigam Pithoragarh
jurisdiction: Pithoragarh municipal corporation area, Pithoragarh district, Uttarakhand
description: Uttarakhand's Urban Development Department lists Pithoragarh as a Nagar Nigam. The 2024-25 election register records 40 wards and the first board on 6 February 2025. The district contact listing still uses the former Nagar Palika name.
